spec.description: 1 means Prometheus or Alloy scraped the target. 0 is down. Red at 80 was wrong: up never reaches 80, so a dead target stayed green.
spec.title: Scrape targets up

spec.description: p95 of snapshot time minus the source updated_at, per source. Yellow at 30s is the HR contract. Red at 300s is the sales, product, and engineering contract. A single 30s red line marked a healthy slower source as failed.
spec.title: Snapshot lag p95

spec.description: Seconds since the last sync that advanced the watermark, per source. A cursor watermark leaves this unset. Yellow at 30s, red at 300s, matching the contract targets. HR polls every 10s. The other sources poll every 60s.
spec.title: Last successful sync age

spec.description: Snapshots written or skipped per second, per source. A skip means version, ACL, and hash already matched. This is a rate, not an error, so it has no red threshold.
spec.title: Snapshot write and skip rate

spec.description: Snapshot failures per second by source and stage. A contract stage is an object that carried an excluded field. enqueue is a publish that failed after the snapshot write.
spec.title: Snapshot errors by stage

spec.description: Absolute difference between snapshot count and source count, per source. Zero is healthy. Negative drift is the same failure as positive drift. Red at one object.
spec.title: Reconciliation drift

spec.description: Delete checks that still found the object, counted over the selected range. The raw counter showed the total since process start. store is s3 on the connector, postgres or neo4j on the worker. Red on any failure in the range.
spec.title: Delete verification failures

spec.description: Logs from every connector. The old query was connector-hr only, so sales, product, and engineering failures were invisible.
spec.title: Connector logs

spec.description: connector and ingestion. 1 is up.
spec.title: Workers up

spec.description: Errors, and lines whose decision is deny. The Loki datasource opens the other lines for the same request_id.
spec.title: Errors and audit denies

spec.description: postgres, neo4j, s3, and sqs. 0 is red. 1 is up.
spec.title: Worker dependencies

spec.description: Event lag is now minus occurred_at when the worker finishes the message, per source. Watermark lag is one series per source. A cursor watermark is omitted. Yellow at 30s is the HR contract. Red at 300s is the other contracts. This is not oldest-message age. SQS does not expose that outside CloudWatch.
spec.title: Sync lag per source

spec.description: Visible messages from GetQueueAttributes, per tier queue.
spec.title: Queue depth

spec.description: Visible messages on each tier dead-letter queue right now. This is a gauge from GetQueueAttributes, not a counter, so it is not wrapped in increase(). Red when any message is visible.
spec.title: Dead-letter depth

spec.description: Skips are unchanged content hashes. The graph write still runs.
spec.title: Embed calls and skips

spec.description: Absolute difference between indexed objects and source_objects, per source. Sits beside snapshot reconciliation drift. Red at one object.
spec.title: Index drift

spec.description: Postgres and Neo4j write time.
spec.title: Store write latency

spec.description: Failed Postgres or Neo4j writes over the selected range. The raw counter showed the total since process start. Red on any failure in the range.
spec.title: Store errors

spec.description: event_type and decision are in the line. request_id is in the line, not a label.
spec.title: Ingestion logs

spec.description: p95 of kbs_retrieval_seconds by tool. Search includes the HR ACL re-check. The unit is seconds. Red above 0.25s, which is the 250 ms target and the 0.25 histogram bucket.
spec.title: Retrieval latency p95

spec.description: Searches with no chunk, divided by all searches, by permission group. Shown as a fraction of 1.
spec.title: Empty-result rate

spec.description: Rejected bearer tokens by reason.
spec.title: Auth failures

spec.description: Product notices over the selected range. ok, invalid, and error are separate series. The raw counter showed the total since process start. invalid and error turn red. ok stays green.
spec.title: Webhook notices

spec.description: Visible messages right now. The main hook queue can hold work, so it stays green. The dead-letter queue turns red at one message. The old panel turned both red.
spec.title: Hook queue depth

spec.description: Finished requests per second by process and route. /health and /metrics are left out so scrapes do not hide traffic. An unknown path is the route unmatched.
spec.title: HTTP request rate

spec.description: Responses at 500 and above, per second, by process, route, and status. Red above zero.
spec.title: HTTP 5xx rate

spec.description: p95 request duration by process and route, in seconds. This is not the 250 ms search target. That target is the retrieval panel.
spec.title: HTTP duration p95

spec.name: source_id
spec.label: Source
spec.description: Limit source series to one department. All keeps every source.

spec.name: surface
spec.label: Surface
spec.description: REST or MCP. All keeps both.

spec.name: permission_group
spec.label: Permission group
spec.description: Highest-privilege group on the empty-result rate. All keeps every group.

spec.name: service
spec.label: Service
spec.description: Filters the error and deny log panel. All keeps every service.
